title: Chipili civic centre and five rural health posts
summary: Supply and installation of solar power at the Chipili civic centre and five rural health posts under the 2025 Constituency Development Fund (CDF).

specs.label: Scope
specs.value: Supply and installation of solar power systems

scope: Supply of solar power systems for six sites
Installation at five rural health posts
challenge: Rural health posts without reliable electricity struggle to provide lighting for night care, power for medical equipment and safe storage of medicines.
solution: Donmac supplied and installed solar power systems across six council and health sites, bringing reliable electricity to facilities that previously lacked it.
outcomes: Reliable electricity at five rural health posts
Solar power for the council's civic centre
Improved energy access for the communities served
